Clariane has launched a proposed offering of €500 million of senior notes to refinance part of its existing indebtedness
Paris, September 7, 2026
— Clariane (CLARI.PA – ISIN FR0010386334) announces today that it has launched an offering (the “
Offering
”) of €500 million in aggregate principal amount of new euro-denominated senior notes due 2032 (the “
Notes
”). The completion of the Offering is subject to market conditions.

Clariane intends to use the net proceeds from the Offering, if completed, together with cash on hand, to (i) repay and cancel in full the term loan facility of €350.0 million made available under its existing facilities agreement, (ii) repay and cancel in full the real estate term loan facility of €150.0 million made available under its real estate term loan facility agreement, and (iii) pay fees and expenses in relation to the Offering.

Clariane has obtained the agreement of its banking partners, subject to the completion of the Offering, to enter into a €700 million revolving credit facility, which would replace its existing facilities agreement. This new €700 million revolving credit facility1 will have a maturity of five years and could be used for the company’s general corporate purposes2. Drawdowns under the facility would bear interest at a floating rate3 determined by reference to the group’s total net leverage ratio, with an additional ESG-linked margin adjustment mechanism. This new revolving credit facility would have a single financial covenant, namely the “Wholeco” total net leverage4. The revolving credit facility would also contain customary restrictions on distributions5.
1 which would include an accordion feature allowing the amount of this credit facility to be increased up to €900 million
2 including capital expenditures and the refinancing of the group’s existing financial indebtedness (excluding hybrid debt)
3 corresponding to the EURIBOR rate plus a margin of 1.75% to 3.50%, determined on the basis of the “Wholeco” total net leverage ratio
4 which is expected to be set below 7.00x until June 2027, with a gradual decrease to 6.75x (in December 2027), 6.50x (in June 2028), 6.25x (in December 2028) and 6.00x from June 2029 onwards
5 including a limitation on annual dividend distributions to 7% of Clariane’s market capitalization, subject to “Wholeco” total net leverage not exceeding 4.5x

The offer and sale of the Notes will be made pursuant to an exemption under the Prospectus Regulation from the requirement to produce a prospectus for offers of securities.

In the United Kingdom, this announcement is directed only at (i) persons having professional experience in matters relating to investments falling within Article 19(5) of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 (Financial Promotion) Order 2005 (the “
Order

About Clariane
Clariane is the leading European community for care in times of vulnerability. It has operations in six countries: Belgium, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands and Spain.

Relying on their diverse expertise, each year the Group’s 70,000 professionals provide care and support to more than 840,000 residents and patients in two major areas of activity: Long Term Care and care for frailties, with its networks of medicalized nursing homes and alternative living solutions (Korian, Âges & Vie and Rosorum, etc.), and Specialty Care, which includes medical, post-acute and rehabilitation activities as well as mental health activities (Inicea, Kormed, Iterias, Grupo 5, etc.).
Clariane is a purpose-driven company whose corporate purpose, common to all its activities, is: “taking care of each person’s humanity in times of vulnerability”.
Clariane has been listed on Euronext Paris, Section B since November 2006. The Group joined the SBF 120 index and the CAC® SBT 1.5° index on September 23, 2024.
